SENSATIONAL DREAM hopped at the start to spotting the field a few lengths, moved into range from inside, waited along the rail on the turn, challenged
outer trio late on the bend, seized control turning for home, kicked clear when roused in upper stretch, drew away under hand urging and remained well
clear to the wire. ICONS ONLY set the pace under pressure from a pair of rivals, maintained a short lead while moving into the two path on the turn,
overtaken by SENSATIONAL DREAM late on the bend, kept on down the lane and secure second. DEBBY'S GAL pressed ICONS ONLY from outside,
fought between rivals on the turn, went three wide into the lane and flattened out in the final furlong. SUGAR LOVIN raced up close three deep, fought in the
three then four path on the turn and weakened in the drive.

TAM'S LITTLE ANGEL stalked the leader outside a rival, challenged from outside at the three-eighths pole, dueled around the bend and put a head in front
at the quarter pole, drew clear midstretch and held safely. FALABELLA got pinballed leaving the gate and had to take up, chased from off the pace on the
inside, got put in a bit tight and checked early on the turn, eased off the rail late on the bend, finished full of run to get up for second but could not reach the
winner. EMPRESS MATILDA (GB) broke out and bumped FALABELLA, settled inside, hugged the rail to the stretch, angled out and finished well but got
outkicked for second. ELITE HEAT (GB) sat off the pace in the early going, traveled two wide on the turn, swung out for the stretch and offered a mild
response to round out the superfecta. MY KAT sped clear and set the tone early, challenged by the winner at the three-eighths pole, dueled around the turn,
failed to keep up with a furlong remaining and weakened. OVETA'S HOBBY broke in and bumped hard at the start causing the rider to lose his balance
momentarily, trailed two then three wide on the turn, angled out in the drive and never threatened. LITTLE TINKER ELLE got bumped hard between rivals
leaving the gate, took a stalking position on the inside, steadied a bit behind the leader into the turn, saved ground to the stretch, moved out in the lane and
weakened. INVINCIBLE MOLLY (GB) tracked the speed from the two path on the turn and weakened. THERE WAS AN INQUIRY INVOLVING EMPRESS
MATILDA (GB), FALABELLA, LITTLE TINKER ELLE AND OVETA'S HOBBY AT THE START. FOLLOWING A REVIEW, THE STEWARDS RULED THAT
OVETA'S HOBBY CONTRIBUTED TO HER OWN PROBLEMS AT THE START AND THERE WOULD BE NO CHANGE.

BLAME ASHLEY absorbed a bump from ASWOME AMY at the start, set a pressured pace from inside, shook free at the three-sixteenths pole and drew
away. JUST LIBERTY pressed the pace from outside up the backstretch and around the turn, failed to keep up with BLAME ASHELY into the stretch and

and got edged for third. PRO PAYNE showed brief speed between rivals then took a stalking position, came under a ride in the two path on the turn and

SAND BAGGER settled along the rail, moved off the fence on the backstretch, angled back to the rail at the five-sixteenths pole, tipped three wide
approaching the stretch, seized control outside the eighth pole, kicked clear under right handed urging in midstretch and was ridden out the last sixteenth.
NON DOMICILE set the pace with LOVE THE PRESSURE alongside, overtaken by that rival past the half-mile pole, regained the lead into the far turn,
inched ahead around the bend, cleared briefly at the three-sixteenths pole, quickly confronted by SAND BAGGER, relinquished the lead into the final furlong
and stayed on to secure second. KNOWHERE took a stalking position along the rail, came under a ride following the leader around the far turn, moved off
the rail in upper stretch and kept trying to earn the show honors. REDIAL dropped off the pace in the three then two path on the first turn, remained two wide
through the second bend and passed tired rivals. LOVE THE PRESSURE prompted the pace from outside, put a head in front past the half-mile pole, gave
the lead back to NON DOMICILE leaving the backstretch, kept the pressure on that rival through the far turn, failed to keep up coming into the stretch and
weakened in the late stages. PRINCE OF DEL MAR stalked in the two path, between rivals at the half-mile pole, got fanned four wide late on the far turn
and weakened. PRECISION (GB) sat off the pace in the two path, made a middle move three deep, got fanned five wide late on the far turn and also
weakened. BAD TO THE BONES trailed along the inside and never got involved.
